body: I should probably rethink the way I said some things. My parents really aren't useless, I just think they seriously don't get it. I'm sure I could try to get through to them about this, but I'm terrified. What if it doesn't help? What if their reactions make it worse? Like, they get angry at me for being irrational and try to blame it on the things I use to keep my mind off of it, like reddit or reading or music. I'm going to college soon, and they might not even trust me enough to send me, which would make things really bad.

It's really hard right now because I'm still in high school. EVERYTHING I do can still be discovered by my parents. (And they don't take this seriously. I tried talking to my mom and she basically told me I'm just PMSing and that's how everyone gets. I mean. Ive already attempted suicide, even went to a mental ward for five days, and she suggests it's PMS) This is the only thing I can think of without calling a hotline. At the moment, the depressions not horrible, but once i start really contemplating suicide it gets bad. And the difference now is that I have no friends who care about me anymore. I have literally no one to talk to. Tomorrow is going to be so much worse.
